name: Valyu
summary: Search API for agents over the web, SEC filings, market data, economics, papers, trials and patents, plus async DeepResearch reports.
notes: The header is x-api-key, not Authorization: Bearer.
Pay per use from a credit balance; paid plans unlock specialist sources (SEC filings, trials, patents); a 403 can mean a plan too low for a dataset.
Async patterns: contents with async true returns a job_id (poll valyu.contents.job); DeepResearch returns a task id (poll valyu.research.status).
The streaming Answer endpoint (POST /v1/answer, server-sent events) is left out.

endpoints.name: Search the web and specialist datasets
endpoints.summary: Ranked results with extracted content from the web, news, SEC filings, market data, papers, trials and patents.

query.description: The search query, in natural language.

max_num_results.description: Maximum results; keep small to control cost.

search_type.description: all (default), web, news or proprietary (the dataset route).

included_sources.description: Dataset ids, presets such as finance, or domains to restrict to.

excluded_sources.description: Domains, dataset ids or presets to leave out.

scope_policy.description: advisory (default) or strict to search every listed dataset.

response_length.description: Content size per result: short (25,000 characters, default), medium, large or max.

start_date.description: Published on or after: YYYY, YYYY-MM-DD or ISO datetime.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code for geo-targeted web results.

fast_mode.description: Skip query rewriting and reranking for lower latency.

url_only.description: Return only URLs; web and news search types only.

max_price.description: Cap on the cost of the whole request.

notes: A read over POST: it only retrieves data.
Priced per result returned: web and news 0.1 credit each, other datasets priced per 1,000 results (see valyu.datasources.list). A 206 means partial success.
Plan limits can skip a dataset and report it in the warnings list instead of failing.

endpoints.name: Extract content from URLs
endpoints.summary: Clean text, a summary or schema-shaped JSON from up to 50 URLs.

urls.description: HTTP(S) URLs to extract. Up to 10 synchronously, up to 50 with async true.

response_length.description: Maximum characters per URL: short (default), medium, large, max.

summary.description: Set for an AI summary or a JSON schema extraction; raises the price.

extract_effort.description: auto (default) or high for pages that need JavaScript rendering.

screenshot.description: Also capture a screenshot per page.

max_age.description: Oldest cached copy accepted, in seconds, 0 to 2592000; 0 forces a live crawl.

async.description: Run in the background and return a job_id; required above 10 URLs.

webhook_url.description: HTTPS URL called when an async job finishes.

notes: A read over POST: it only retrieves data.
Asynchronous when async is true: the response carries a job_id. Poll valyu.contents.job with it.
0.2 credits per extracted URL, 0.6 with summary; failed URLs are free. Inspect each result: a 206 means some URLs failed.

endpoints.name: Poll an async extraction job
endpoints.summary: Status and results of a job started by valyu.contents.extract with async true.

job_id.description: The job_id returned by the async extraction request.

notes: Polls the job started by valyu.contents.extract. Only the key that created a job can read it.

endpoints.name: Start a DeepResearch task
endpoints.summary: Starts an asynchronous research agent that returns a cited report. Poll with valyu.research.status.

query.description: The research question or brief, up to 25,000 characters.

mode.description: Depth and price: instant (8 credits), fast (25), standard (100, default), heavy (500) or max (2,500).

research_strategy.description: Natural-language guidance for how to search.

urls.description: URLs to include as context, max 10.

notes: Starts a billed job that only produces data, so it is kind read.
Asynchronous: the response carries a task id. Poll valyu.research.status with that id; instant mode finishes in under 30 seconds, heavier modes take minutes.
Billed a fixed number of credits per task by mode.

endpoints.name: Get a DeepResearch task's status and result
endpoints.summary: Status, and when finished the report, sources and cost of a task from valyu.research.create.
notes: Polls the task started by valyu.research.create.

endpoints.name: Cancel a DeepResearch task
endpoints.summary: Stops a running or queued task.
notes: Answers 409 if the task already finished.

endpoints.name: List data sources
endpoints.summary: Every dataset Valyu can search, with id, category, description and price per 1,000 results.

endpoints.name: Find data sources by description
endpoints.summary: Datasets matching a plain-language description of the data you need.
